title: Working for the Clyde Beatty circus
summary: Punch describes two summers with the Beatty show playing parades and a colored revue, and playing Maryland.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What about Clyde Beatty? You told me you worked for him once. Oh yeah, the animal man. Yeah I worked for Clyde Beatty in there.

Big stone there and blowed everything down. Blowed the top down on us man. I used to get the parking lot and cut my way through. Where was that? Up in uh somewhere in Wisconsin. Yeah I worked for two summers I mean. Two summers. What kind of stuff you played? Oh we had a college show on there. Oh? A college show. But we tried to play, when we get to town you know, play parades you know. Played parades. We didn't get off and play that night and play something. I thought maybe you played Tiger Rag a lot. Well no I didn't play it up there. When I left New Orleans I didn't play Tiger Rag no more. Why not? Well I mean there wasn't nobody, I don't know if they weren't playing it, but the only band I was playing was the Dixieland. You know they played it. But I mean them boys in Chicago, there's nobody, no Tiger Rag. There's King Harv and them. I don't know if they played it. I don't believe he did. Of course King Harv was making up all this, remember the Connell Street blues, Tip of Mouth blues and all that stuff.
He's making up his songs. Well what about that Clyde Beatty show again? What tunes would you play with that?

Well I'll tell you how that was. We played parades, we had marches you know for that. But we had a big colored review on there, see. We'd open up with overtune and the chorus come out. After that a comedian, then a singer, a tap dancer and all like that. See we played for all that you know.
Did the circus carry a regular band punch or were you all considered the circus bands?

Yeah, no we wasn't the circus band. We was like you got a show see, where you hired a band. And the circus band was a white band see, but we had to parade with them behind them. And when they got to the top, well they played the white. All for the animals and things like that see. But we had our tent you know. You ain't never been on a con, have you? Well I've seen them. Well I mean we had big colored shows, sits way in the back all the time.
Everybody come in, white and colored, everybody positive.
Well, what kind of marches would you play with Beatty?
Well, something on the autograph. No, one we played a lot, Maryland. Maryland, we played that a lot.
Did the band get hot on that, or did they just read it?
Well, around the last part of it. Hmm.
